test_title: PYST 37: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They noted down the details very carefully.

options.text: The details were noted down by them very carefully.
The details was being noted down by them very carefully
The details had been noted down by them very carefully.
The details were being noted down by them very carefully

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **active voice sentence** "They noted down the details very carefully," the **subject is** "They," the **verb is** "noted down," and the** object is** "the details."
 
• **To convert this** sentence to passive voice, the** object (the details) becomes** the subject in the passive sentence, the **verb is changed to **its appropriate passive form, and the subject (They) becomes the agent of the action.
 
• In this case, the **correct passive form** is "were noted down" to maintain the **past tense.**
 
• **"By them"** is added to indicate the agent of the action, that is, the person who noted down the details.
 
• **Sentence structure **formula for Passive Voice: Subject + auxiliary verb (be) + past participle + (by + agent)

Therefore, the **correct passive sentence** is :*"The details were noted down by them very carefully."*
